toolkit.title: Gmail
toolkit.access: Doddy can list your recent emails (sender, subject, a short preview), read one email aloud when you ask (the newest that matches), and create drafts, including a reply in an email's own conversation (to its sender), after you tap Create. Doddy never sends, deletes or labels email. Google's draft permission also allows sending; Doddy has no send tool.

tools.name: check_email
tools.title: Check my email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest emails: sender, subject and a short preview. It doesn't open full messages.

tools.name: read_email
tools.title: Read an email
tools.blurb: Reads one email aloud when you ask, the newest that matches. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Gmail after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it.

tools.name: draft_email_reply
tools.title: Draft a reply
tools.blurb: Creates a reply draft in an email's conversation, to its sender, after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it. Off until you switch it on.

receipt.summary: Connected, but the access granted to Gmail is broader than Doddy needs, so Doddy won't use it. Disconnect and reconnect.
